_about_file: BuildBox UI strings — English master. Do not edit this file; translate the template file instead.
about_tagline: Compile Swift on GitHub, sign on-device with your certificate, install — all from your iPhone.
catalog_add_app_footnote: The request opens on GitHub and is sent with your own GitHub account — that keeps spam out. If it is approved, the app appears in the Catalog for every BuildBox user.
catalog_add_app_intro: Suggest an app for the BuildBox Catalog. Every request is reviewed by MikeBuilds before it is published for everyone.
catalog_add_app_paste_hint: Paste the link first — a GitHub project, an IPA or a source JSON.
catalog_load_error: Could not load the catalog. Check your connection and reopen the app.
catalog_source_not_valid_json: Could not read that source — it is not a valid app source JSON.
catalog_source_url_invalid: That source URL is not valid.
catalog_sources_footnote: Downloads are unsigned IPAs — they open in the Sign tab, ready to sign and install. Sources you add are your own responsibility; the BuildBox Catalog is curated by MikeBuilds.
catalog_wifi_required_message: You have 'Wi-Fi only downloads' turned on. Connect to a Wi-Fi network to download.
cert_remove_message: Are you sure you want to remove the certificate? You will need to import it again to sign.
cert_setup_note: One-time setup — like ESign: your .p12 certificate and .mobileprovision profile. They stay on this iPhone.
compile_clear_log_message: Are you sure you want to clear the build log and the compiled IPA?
compile_disconnect_message: Are you sure you want to disconnect?
compile_github_required_body: Connect your GitHub account to compile. Your code stays in your private repos — we never see it. Uses your free Actions minutes.
compile_hint_add_source: Add Swift source or a ZIP file to enable compiling
compile_hint_connect: Connect GitHub above to enable compiling
compile_hint_project_name: Enter a project name to enable compiling
compile_how_to_body: Compiling runs on GitHub because an iPhone can't run a full Swift compiler — everything after that (signing, installing) happens right on your device.
compile_status_download_failed: Build done but IPA download failed
compile_status_invalid_token: Invalid token. Check it and try again.
compile_step1_body: Tap Connect GitHub and add your account — one time only. Your code compiles in your own private repos, using your free GitHub Actions minutes.
compile_step2_body: Write or paste Swift code, or import a project (.zip). Give your project a name — each project gets its own repo.
compile_step3_body: Tap Compile and follow the log. GitHub builds your code in the cloud and turns it into an unsigned IPA.
compile_step4_body: When the build finishes, your IPA opens in the Sign tab — ready to sign with your certificate and install.
compile_token_help: Create one at github.com → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Tokens (classic) → Generate new token. Give it a name, check the boxes above, then Generate. Copy the token (starts with 'ghp_') and paste it here. You'll log in with your GitHub email/password on the website — we never see it.
compile_token_keychain: Token is saved in your iPhone's Keychain (secure, on-device only)
compile_token_never_see_password: We never see your GitHub password
compile_token_never_store: We never store your password — only the token
compile_token_private_repos: Your code goes only to your private repos
library_empty:
No signed IPAs yet.

Sign an app in the Sign tab and it will live here — ready to install anytime, without signing again.
library_remove_message: This deletes the signed IPA from the library. You would have to sign it again to get it back.
settings_cert_expires_message: Expires December 25, 2026. Renewal comes with the next BuildBox update.
settings_no_custom_sources_message: You haven't added your own sources yet. Sources you add in Sources can be exported from here.
sign_clear_ipa_message: Are you sure you want to clear the imported IPA?
sign_error_bundle_not_found: App bundle not found in IPA
sign_error_create_output: Could not create the output IPA
sign_error_nothing_injectable: Injection: none of the attached files contained anything BuildBox can inject — attach a .dylib, .deb, .framework, .bundle or a .zip containing them
sign_error_read_executable: Injection: cannot read the app's executable name
sign_error_signing_not_implemented: Binary signing requires full Mach-O implementation
sign_injection_help: Attach dylibs, .deb tweak packages, .framework or .bundle folders — or a .zip containing any of them. Everything's placed inside the app and loaded at launch. How tweaks and mods are made.
sign_progress_keeping_version: Keeping original version fields (build number preserved)
sign_remove_injection_message: Are you sure you want to remove \(itemToRemove?.lastPathComponent ?? "this file")?
sign_status_certificate_files_missing: Certificate files missing — reimport it in the Certificate section above
sign_status_certificate_not_found: Certificate not found — reimport it in the Certificate section above
settings_clear_cache_message: This clears cached catalog images and temporary files. Your signed IPAs, sources and settings won't be affected.
sources_add_hint: Paste a full https:// link to a source JSON.
